name: Madhusudan Mishra

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Madhusudan Mishra is a retired Indian Administrative Service officer and the registrar of Jagadguru Kripalu University in Odisha. The university records his earlier service as district collector in Nayagarh, Boudh and Sonepur, as well as a beginning in teaching political science. Alongside this career in administration, his Kabita Live contributions explore memory, affection and the stories attached to place.

‘Sashisena Temple, Sonepur’ retells a local love legend as a celebration of a woman’s freedom to choose. His other poems turn towards the persistence of feeling: letters lost to a river, a schoolmate remembered across decades, and love imagined as light travelling beyond distance. The classroom, riverbank and familiar landscape become places where time passes but emotional memory remains.
